name: Waking Legends
label: Quest
description: Waking Legends: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The waters of Lake Elune'ara should dissolve the nightmares engulfing this object. Give me a moment to perform the cleansing, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Take his ring, friend. It has served its purpose for Malfurion. It shall now serve a new purpose for you...
